items.title: Distribute Press Releases Prices Every Release at $99 or Less, With 15 Deliverables Included and No Add-On Menu
items.summary: Distribute Press Releases now sells a single release for $99, five for $399 and a 12-release year for $890, each with the same 15 deliverables and no add-on fees.
items.content_text: Distribute Press Releases, the Denver press release service run by Eye To Ad Media, now prices a complete release at $99, with the same 15 deliverables in every release and no add-on menu. Five releases cost $399, about $80 each. A monthly plan is $89 for one release a month, and an annual plan of 12 releases is $890, about $74 each, which works out to two months free. Most press release services quote a low base price and then charge separately for extra words, images, wider distribution or search features. Distribute Press Releases builds those into one price. The client sends the facts, and the service writes the release and runs one editorial pass. Nothing publishes until the client approves the final draft, and approved releases go live within one to two business days of the facts. Each release ships with a permanent canonical URL; NewsArticle and Organization structured data validated before publishing; a claims file that lists each fact as a dated, attributed statement that search engines and AI systems can lift; a clean markdown copy; a narrated MP3 the client keeps; a podcast episode with transcript; RSS, Atom, JSON Feed and Media RSS feeds filtered by industry and region;
